claim: On April 20, 1993, President Clinton was speaking with Ambassador to the United Nations Madeleine Albright in the Oval Office.

evidence.quote: President Clinton speaking with Ambassador to the United Nations Madeleine Albright, Secretary of State Warren Christopher, National Security Advisor Tony Lake, George Stephanopoulos and others in the Oval Office.
The images were photographed by Bob McNeely on April 20, 1993.

notes: Ratio-lift RL-F-011 (reworded to the record's words; cites the file unit already on file, ALB-S-0134, instead of a second copy RL-S-015). Ties the April 1993 frames to her; the room is labelled "the Oval Office, April 1993" (task 14b ruling); ALB-F-0193 (1997 swearing-in) stays the chapter's event. Chapter albright/secretary.
